title: Optimal Incentive-Compatible Assignments with Endogenous School Priorities
abstract: arXiv:2610.28582v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study whether a planner can favor students at schools they rank more highly while preserving truthful reporting. The standard implementation of the deferred acceptance (DA) algorithm is typically not the solution. With interior cutoffs, DA with multiple tie-breaking (DA-MTB) solves the planner's optimization problem if and only if the planner's payoff from a school assignment is independent of the students' preferences. This is typically not the case, and strict incentive compatibility under DA-MTB leaves room for improvement via preference-dependent priority adjustments. We characterize optimal rank-dependent cutoff adjustments in a two-school model and show that, in a many-school environment, near-optimal approximately incentive-compatible assignments can be chosen with small support (so each type of student may only attend a small number of schools).

translated_title: 具有内生学校优先权的最优激励相容分配机制
translated_abstract: 我们研究规划者能否在学校中优待那些将该学校排名更高的学生，同时保持学生真实汇报偏好的激励相容性。延迟接受（DA）算法的标准实施方式通常无法解决这一问题。当存在内部截止分数线时，只有当规划者从学校分配中获得的收益与学生的偏好无关时，采用多重打破平局的延迟接受算法（DA-MTB）才能解决规划者的优化问题。然而通常情况并非如此，因此DA-MTB下的严格激励相容性为通过依赖偏好的优先权调整来改进结果留下了空间。我们在两学校模型中刻画了最优的依赖排名的截止分数线调整方式，并证明在多学校环境中，可以以较小的支撑集（即每种类型的学生只需被分配到少数几所学校）实现接近最优的近似激励相容分配。
tldr: 规划者可以通过依赖学生偏好和排名的优先权调整来优待学生的更高志愿学校，而标准DA-MTB仅在规划者收益与学生偏好无关时才最优。
en_tdlr: A planner can favor students at schools they rank more highly while preserving (approximate) incentive compatibility by using preference-dependent priority and cutoff adjustments, since standard DA-MTB is optimal only when the planner's payoff is preference-independent.
